questions.q: This sign indicates a T-shaped road intersection ahead.
When making a right turn and an oncoming straight-moving vehicle yields, you must turn quickly.
questions.explanation: Safety checks for hidden motorcycles or pedestrians are necessary.

questions.q: When a vehicle breaks down in a railway crossing, you should use the crossing obstruction alert device to notify the train driver and avoid using flares to prevent fire hazards.
questions.explanation: If no obstruction alert device is available, flares should be used.

questions.q: Starting from the roadside is not considered a lane change.
questions.explanation: Starting from the roadside is also considered a lane change.

questions.q: Even in a no-lane-change zone, you may change lanes if roadwork prevents passage.
This sign indicates a T-shaped road intersection ahead.
questions.explanation: This is a sign indicating merging traffic ahead.

questions.q: Signs are divided into main signs and auxiliary signs, with main signs consisting of four types: regulatory, instruction, warning, and guide signs.
Light vehicles cannot travel on a roadside strip marked by two solid white lines.
When driving on a road without a sidewalk or roadside strip, vehicles must not veer onto the shoulder.
When crossing a sidewalk to enter a store, you may drive slowly if it is clear there are no pedestrians.
questions.explanation: You must stop temporarily when crossing a sidewalk.

questions.q: This sign indicates a maximum speed of 50 km/h, allowing regular cars, regular motorcycles, and motorized bicycles to reach up to 50 km/h.
questions.explanation: Motorized bicycles are limited to a legal speed of 30 km/h.

questions.q: The stopping distance for a regular car traveling at 50 km/h is approximately 32 meters.
Driver’s licenses are divided into two categories: first-class and second-class licenses.
questions.explanation: There are three categories: first-class, second-class, and provisional licenses.

questions.q: You must not carry passengers in areas other than seats, but in a cargo vehicle, a minimum number of people can ride in the cargo area to monitor the load.
Parking or stopping is prohibited within 10 meters of an intersection and its edges.
questions.explanation: The restriction applies within 5 meters of an intersection.

questions.q: At an intersection with this sign and no stop line, you must stop immediately before the intersection.
At an unregulated intersection, if a tram approaches from the right, you may proceed as the left side has priority.
questions.explanation: Trams have priority over other vehicles.

questions.q: When passing a tram stopped at a stop, you must stop temporarily even if there is a safety zone.
questions.explanation: You may pass slowly without stopping.

questions.q: When passing a stopped vehicle, you must be cautious of doors suddenly opening or people emerging from behind.
If a vehicle must be parked on a highway due to an accident, hazard lights or similar must be activated.
This sign indicates a safety zone.
questions.explanation: This is an instruction sign indicating a priority road.

questions.q: Overtaking is allowed in a tunnel if there are marked lanes.
If the center line is a white broken line, you may overtake by crossing into the right side of the road.
You cannot park where there is less than 3.5 meters of space on the right side of the road, but stopping for loading/unloading with the driver ready to move is an exception.
If a property damage accident is settled on the spot, it is not necessary to report to the police.
questions.explanation: All accidents must be reported to the police.

questions.q: This sign indicates the lane assignment for large trucks, specific medium trucks, and large special vehicles on expressways.
questions.explanation: This is a sign for lane assignments for towing vehicles on expressways.

questions.q: The legal maximum speed is the highest speed set by law for roads without designated speed signs or markings.
Overtaking is moving ahead of a vehicle in front by changing the path.
questions.explanation: Overtaking involves moving ahead without changing paths.

questions.q: If you have a large special vehicle license, you can drive a regular motorcycle.
questions.explanation: A large special vehicle license allows driving only large special vehicles, small special vehicles, and motorized bicycles.

questions.q: When inspecting a motorcycle chain, you must press the middle to check for excessive looseness or tightness and ensure proper lubrication.
This sign indicates a facility or factory handling hazardous materials ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that vehicles carrying hazardous materials cannot pass.

questions.q: The 'R' on an automatic vehicle’s gear lever stands for reverse and is used for backing up.
When passing the crest of a blind uphill slope, you must sound the horn even without a 'sound horn' sign.
questions.explanation: You may pass without sounding the horn.

questions.q: If it is unclear whether pedestrians or bicycles are present at a pedestrian or bicycle crossing, you must stop temporarily.
questions.explanation: You may proceed at a speed that allows stopping if necessary.

questions.q: Tire chains should be fitted to the drive wheels.
This marking indicates approaching a safety zone or roadside obstacle.
When an emergency vehicle approaches on a one-way road, you must always pull over to the left side to yield.
questions.explanation: If it obstructs progress, you may pull to the right side.

questions.q: Driving on a wet road increases the free-running distance.
questions.explanation: It increases the braking distance.

questions.q: Parking is prohibited within 10 meters before and after the left side of a safety zone, but stopping is allowed.
questions.explanation: Both parking and stopping are prohibited.

questions.q: Parking or stopping is prohibited within 5 meters of a road curve.
This marking indicates a pedestrian or bicycle crossing.
questions.explanation: This marking indicates a priority road.

questions.q: The maximum height of cargo on a regular motorcycle is 2.0 meters from the loading device.
questions.explanation: The maximum height is 2.0 meters from the ground.

questions.q: If a license is revoked or expires, it does not need to be returned.
questions.explanation: The license must be returned.

questions.q: When performing a two-stage right turn with a motorized bicycle, you must first move as close as possible to the left edge of the road.
A bus-only lane can be used by regular cars outside of designated hours.
This sign indicates that vehicles can park.
questions.explanation: This is a sign indicating that stopping is allowed.

questions.q: Road markings are divided into two types: regulatory and instruction markings.
On highways, two-person riding on a motorcycle is allowed for those over 20 years old who have held a motorcycle license for at least three years.
If a vehicle breaks down and is parked on the shoulder of a highway, it is safer to stay inside the vehicle due to external dangers.
questions.explanation: Staying outside the vehicle is safer due to the risk of rear-end collisions.

questions.q: There is no time limit for stopping to pick up or drop off passengers.
